text_block_list.text:
Senior Class, the New Year's Hatsumode 
shrine visit. I decided to meet up with 
T.M. Opera O on site.

She hasn't arrived at the meeting spot 
yet. However, a voice can be heard coming 
from the shrine's main hall...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! A prayer to the gods, is it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to having people cling to me, but 
clinging to someone else just isn't my 
style, you know...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you insist, I wouldn't mind 
making a wish.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, God. Why don't you try asking 
me to 'make a request' instead?
choice_data_list: T.M. Opera O, let's take this aside

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To the side!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Standing here, people might end up 
praying to me instead of God.

After hurriedly moving away from the 
center...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but thinking of a wish befitting an 
"Overlord" is quite a vexing problem.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, for one who possesses all things, 
what left is there for me to wish for?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Asking to "make me the Overlord of the End 
of the Century!" would probably be a bit 
too heavy a burden, though...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, could you think of a suitable 
wish for me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Something truly fitting for an "Overlord", 
straight to the point!

A wish befitting an "Overlord"... If I 
dare make one, it would be...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A Manchu-Han Imperial Feast! I see, so 
you're asking me to prepare a lavish 
banquet, then.
(VROOOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhh, my body is moving on its own! 
Could this be divine guidance?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Follow my lead, Trainer-kun!
And so, the place we were led to was—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A ramen shop... Quite run-down, isn't it? 
Well, they're both Chinese-derived, I 
suppose...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If the base is the same, perhaps it can 
pose as an imperial feast. Very well, let 
us do this.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Master, I'll have the 'All Toppings' bowl. 
That's the most extravagant one, right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If anything, let's go all out and top it 
with both gyoza and fried rice!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"This is our New Year's Special: the 
'Overlord Ramen: Extreme'!"

TM Opera O devoured the extra-large ramen 
that was served. Thanks to that, her 
energy was fully restored!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A career change to Demon King! I see... 
So instead of the 'End-of-Century 
Overlord,' becoming an evil Demon King is 
an option too."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating. Since it's the New Year, let 
us stray from the righteous path. Behold, 
I am the Demon King! Heavens, rage wildly!
(Flash! Ka-boom!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Fall, O rain! Drench all 
mankind, and all Umamusume alike!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, this game has way more sizzle than I 
expected! I feel even more magnificent 
than usual!

"Acting like a Demon King seemed to make 
T.M. Opera O feel thoroughly emboldened."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A restoration of the monarchy! Ah, render 
unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, 
I see.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is time we took back control 
from those in power.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
President, we need to talk. It's regarding 
none other than the structure of this 
academy.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it about time we reverted from a 
democracy that elects a president back to 
a monarchy?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard anything about Tracen 
Academy being a monarchy, though...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now listen. Monarchy has its own superior 
points, you know. For example...

T.M. Opera O speaks eloquently. Her 
exchange with Symboli Rudolf seems to have 
broadened her horizons.
